work.name: OceanOS
work.summary: Developed a marine foundation model using geospatial data to support oceanic intelligence and marine conservation.
highlights: Created geospatial pretraining datasets from NetCDF/Zarr files using Xarray.
Designed 3D spatiotemporal model architecture for marine data.
Built Dockerized, multi-GPU training pipeline with cloud support.
Implemented training failsafes including unit tests and cloud backups.
Used CodeCarbon for environmental monitoring.
Achieved 35× training speedup without performance loss.
Developed end-to-end forecasting model.

projects.name: Reproducing NevIR: Negation in Neural Information Retrieval
highlights: Published at SIGIR 2025.
Replicated and extended NevIR to assess IR models' handling of negation.
Found only cross-encoders and listwise LLM re-rankers achieved moderate performance—still below human level.
Showed poor generalization when fine-tuning across negation datasets.

projects.name: Geometric Algebra Simplicial Transformer
highlights: Proposed a novel class of equivariant transformers.
Leveraged simplicial complexes and Clifford algebra to capture full symmetry group equivariance.

projects.name: Predicting Perceived Attributes of Urban Images
highlights: Investigated the use of GIST features to cluster Amsterdam street scenes.
Explored how well these clusters capture perceived attributes of urban environments.

projects.name: Robustness Against Label Noise in Road Defect Severity Estimation
highlights: Researched CNN-based road defect severity estimation and classification.
Studied impact of label noise and proposed robustness strategies.
